$comment: The in-app news item for Smart Scheduling (docs/news.md), written by the rollout-news-writer agent from input/smart-scheduling/feature.md and the brief.
title: Book meetings right inside the conversation
summary: Smart Scheduling is here: offer open times from your team's calendars in one click, and the meeting is booked, confirmed and reminded automatically.

sections.title: How it works
bullets: Click Suggest times in the composer to add three open slots
Customers reply with a number or a tap to book
Confirmations and reminders go out on their own
